name: Murder Build
recommended_characters: The Itchy Finger, The Shieldbearer, The Repentant
core_balls: Magma, Black Hole, Mosquito King, Haemorrhage
core_passives: Crown of Thorns, Hourglass, Ethereal Cloak
strategy: Stack AOE status effects to clear screens. Magma + Black Hole for wave clear, Haemorrhage for boss phases.
strengths: Best overall clear speed, works on all biomes, scales infinitely
weaknesses: Requires specific evolution paths, weak before first evolution

name: Control Build
core_passives: Eye of the Beholder, Breastplate, Fleet Feet
strategy: Lock down enemies with freeze/blind. Frozen Flame melts tanky targets while Sandstorm blinds crowds.
strengths: Excellent survivability, great for learning, consistent
weaknesses: Slower kill speed vs pure DPS builds

name: Boss Melter
core_passives: Deadeye's Amulet, Diamond Hilted Dagger, Hourglass
strategy: Stack bleed via Haemorrhage for 20% HP chunks on bosses. Nuclear Bomb as emergency clear. Sun for sustained AOE.
strengths: Fastest boss kills in game, melts health bars
weaknesses: Weak wave clear, needs team support passives for mobs

name: Sustain Tank
core_balls: Mosquito King, Vampire Lord, Spider Queen
core_passives: Everflowing Goblet, Bandage Roll, Artificial Heart
strategy: Never die. Mosquito King + Vampire Lord provide constant healing while Spider Queen adds minions.
strengths: Nearly unkillable, excellent for deep/farming runs
weaknesses: Kill speed can be slow, bad vs time-sensitive content

name: Swarm Master
strategy: Overwhelm the field with minions. Every hit spawns more allies. Nosferatu is the ultimate form.
weaknesses: Requires late-game evolutions, weak early game

name: Laser Grid
core_balls: Holy Laser, Frozen Flame, The Sun
strategy: Holy Laser covers the entire field. Add status effects for passive damage while lasers clean up.
strengths: Full field coverage, consistent damage, good at all stages
